name: Cadillac Gage V-150 Commando
armament: Twin 7.62 mm or 12.7 mm turret; 20/90 mm turret versions
protection: Cadloy steel, amphibious. Game: immune to small-calibre rounds (5.45/5.56/5.8/7.62x39/7.62x51 ball); 7.62x54R and larger penetrate side/rear and disable tyres and engine; any launcher destroys it.
visual_notes: Boat-shaped 4x4 with a sharp V nose and sloped sides
Large wheels at the extreme ends of the hull, side doors
Small turret or open MG ring; Philippine and Taiwanese MP use, Vietnamese captured stock
